integrity_statement: Analytic claims follow from proper Lyapunov identities, compact omega-limit invariance and local center/stable-manifold theory; exact symbolic and finite numerical checks are corroborative and not independent proof of global statements. Published priority may be incomplete.
scientific_limitations: Claims apply to the unswitched polynomial flow for a,b,c>0. No classification is asserted for nontrivial dynamics when c<b; global exceptional strong-stable manifold is immersed and of measure zero, not necessarily globally embedded. Logarithmic clock is pointwise in parameters and excludes the exponentially convergent exceptional manifold.
title: Sharp global stabilization and logarithmic critical relaxation in a quadratic Lorenz-like flow
